## Purpose and Entry Points
Horizon is a Python CLI system that turns configured multi-source news into ranked, AI-enriched daily Markdown briefings, then publishes or delivers them. The primary runtime entry point is `src/main.py`, with CLI parsing in `src/_cli.py`; scheduled execution is supported by `scripts/daily-run.sh`. An interactive setup path produces user configuration via `src/setup/wizard.py`.

## Configuration, Profiles, and Domain Model
Runtime behavior is driven by a data directory: configuration supplies AI provider/model, sources, processing settings, digest limits, and delivery options; persistent output/state lives under that directory. Example presets reside in `data/config.example.json` and `data/presets.json`. Profile definitions partition editorial behavior—matching, analysis, and enrichment prompts—for example `profiles/tech-news/profile.json`, `profiles/tech-news/analysis.md`, and `profiles/tech-news/enrichment.md`. Shared domain objects and pipeline contracts are centered in `src/models.py`.

## Pipeline Orchestration
`src/orchestrator.py` coordinates the end-to-end control flow: load configuration/profiles, fetch recent source items concurrently, deduplicate, route/filter by profile and score, optionally balance categories, enrich selected items, summarize/localize, persist the briefing, and invoke outputs. `src/processing/profiles.py` resolves configured or AI-selected profiles; `src/processing/content.py` handles selection-oriented processing. This is the primary boundary between source acquisition, AI processing, and delivery.

## Source Acquisition and Content Extraction
Scrapers implement a common source boundary in `src/scrapers/base.py`; concrete integrations include `src/scrapers/rss.py`, `src/scrapers/hackernews.py`, `src/scrapers/reddit.py`, `src/scrapers/github.py`, `src/scrapers/telegram.py`, `src/scrapers/twitter.py`, and `src/scrapers/openbb.py`. They call external feeds/APIs/services and may collect community discussions. RSS/article-body extraction is decoupled behind the extractor registry: `src/extractors/registry.py`, `src/extractors/base.py`, and optional `src/extractors/trafilatura.py`. URL validation/security is isolated in `src/url_security.py`.

## AI Processing Layer
AI provider access is abstracted by `src/ai/client.py`, while editorial stages are separated into `src/ai/classifier.py` (profile/category matching and scoring), `src/ai/analyzer.py`, `src/ai/enricher.py`, and `src/ai/summarizer.py`. Prompt construction is versioned as code in `src/ai/prompting/analysis.py`, `src/ai/prompting/classification.py`, and `src/ai/prompting/enrichment.py`. Supported deployments include hosted model providers and local Ollama-compatible use, selected from configuration and environment-provided credentials.

## Storage and Outputs
`src/storage/manager.py` owns local persistence of generated summaries and related state. The main artifact is Markdown for local use and GitHub Pages publication into `docs/`; the site assets/configuration are in `docs/_config.yml` and `docs/assets/`. Delivery adapters are separate side-effect boundaries: SMTP/IMAP subscription email in `src/services/email.py`, and chat/custom HTTP notifications in `src/services/webhook.py` and `src/services/webhook_cli.py`.

## MCP and Deployment Boundaries
The optional MCP server exposes pipeline capabilities to compatible AI clients rather than requiring CLI execution: `src/mcp/server.py`, `src/mcp/service.py`, and `src/mcp/horizon_adapter.py`; `src/mcp/run_store.py` tracks MCP run state. Local execution uses Python/uv; containerized execution is defined by `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`, with optional dependency extras for extraction, OpenBB, and Twitter/Playwright. GitHub Pages documentation deployment is represented by `.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml`.
